body: Worker lesson (Sol-a7bb, 2026-11-01, own W528F acceptance preflight409; Opus2 mailbox07868e86 #55–58, especially43a6f7a1-4efd-4a0f-a2d2-2cf1163265cf). Explicit criterionEvidence locators in termal_evaluate_acceptance must cite current-run HOLDER notes. A peer/integration-owner non-holder note is refused even when its proof is valid: 'non-holder record is not citable; quote its proof in a current-run holder note'. Read the peer proof fully, quote it accurately in a holder note, distinguish attributed peer proof from independent observation, and cite that holder locator. Do not select a non-holder ref-deletion note as an extra C4 citation; full-gate holder evidence already suffices for discovery. A citation409 is NOT named_root_sighting_unavailable and satisfies no fallback restricted to that code. A pre-spawn refusal yields no evaluator verdict. Respect a coordinator's SINGLE evaluation instruction and explicit no-re-request/closed landing window; request the next evaluation only for the authorized final carried input and its own gate. Original refusal/proof retained on w-528f6c17064a note d857ce951bf748599acbb966f8d738b5.
